result.instructions: Director renders video from HTML/CSS, Rhai and native projects. `open` an input to get a session id and its outline, then `patch` nodes by authored name against the session revision (`node` reads a record and lists the JSON pointers `patch` takes), `inspect` layout and timeline, `render_frame` to look at a frame, `qa` to score it, and `export` the video. Failed tools return `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

tools.description: Open an input as a session at revision 0. Returns the session id, source kind, missing fonts, compositions and outline.

duration.description: Seconds for inputs that do not set a duration (default 5)

fps.description: Frame rate for inputs that do not set one (default 30)

height.description: Canvas height for inputs that do not set one (default 1080)

input.description: Rhai, HTML, capture JSON, native .dirproj or core project JSON path, relative to the server directory

props.description: Script composition props as JSON or a JSON file path

width.description: Canvas width for inputs that do not set one (default 1920)

tools.name: open

tools.description: Close a session and free its renderers.
tools.name: close

tools.description: The node tree with authored names, the clips and the current revision.
tools.name: outline

tools.description: A node's document record, or the value at a JSON pointer inside it, by authored name or node id. `leaves` lists every settable pointer below it, each one a `path` that `patch` `set` takes.

leaves.description: Also list every settable leaf below `path` as `{pointer: value}`; colors and other objects of numbers are one leaf

generation.description: Slot generation. A recycled slot has a new generation.

node.description: Authored name (an HTML `id`) or `{"index","generation"}` node id, as `patch` takes it

path.description: JSON pointer inside the node record, such as `/body`; the whole record when absent

tools.name: node

tools.description: Document, added, removed, moved and changed nodes between two sessions as JSON pointers, with `patch`: the ops that turn `before` into `after` when `patchable`.
tools.name: diff

tools.description: Apply patch ops atomically and return the new revision. `set` replaces the value at a JSON pointer in a node record (`{"op":"set","node":"box","path":"/opacity","value":0.5}`), `set_document` one in the document, `remove` drops a subtree.

base_revision.description: Revision the ops were written against; a stale revision fails with `conflict`. Defaults to the current revision.

ops.description: Ops applied in order; any failure rejects them all

oneOf.description: Replace the value at JSON pointer `path` inside the node record, such as `/opacity` or `/body/text`. Identity and tree fields (`/id`, `/parent`, `/children`) are fixed.

generation.description: Slot generation. A recycled slot has a new generation.

node.description: A node by authored name (an HTML `id`) or by generational id.

oneOf.description: Replace the value at JSON pointer `path` of the document, such as `/fps` or `/timeline/tracks/0/clips/0/duration`. `/version` is fixed and `/nodes` changes through the node ops.
Remove the node and its subtree. A clip's scene root or a mask that a remaining node uses cannot be removed.

generation.description: Slot generation. A recycled slot has a new generation.

node.description: A node by authored name (an HTML `id`) or by generational id.

tools.name: patch

tools.description: Source ids, layout bounds, timeline and audio of the current revision at a time.
tools.name: inspect

tools.description: Score the current revision 0-100 for publishing. Errors cost 20: missing fonts, nodes never on the canvas, clipped or non-finite audio. Warnings cost 5: text clipped by the canvas edge or inside the safe-zone inset for a second or more, captions over faces, reframed subjects out of frame, true peak above -1 dBTP, a silent mix, loudness more than 2 LU off target. Static stretches are info. `pass` holds with no errors. Each issue carries the authored node name, time range and a fix. Reports progress when the request carries a `progressToken`.

loudness_target.description: Integrated loudness target of the audio mix in LUFS

tools.name: qa

tools.description: Paint one frame of the current revision as PNG.

output.description: Write the PNG here and return its path; without it the PNG returns as image content. It must resolve inside the server directory, the session's input directory or an `--allow-dir` root

tools.name: render_frame

tools.description: Export the current revision as a video file, with an audio stream only when the scene has audio tracks. Reports encoded frames as progress when the request carries a `progressToken`. Fails with `missing_font` when required fonts are absent and `output_outside_root` for a path outside the allowed roots.

alpha.description: Leave uncovered pixels clear and write VP9 with alpha

output.description: Video path inside the server directory, the session's input directory or an `--allow-dir` root

tools.name: export
